title: SINOTRUK showcases new-energy commercial vehicles at IAA Transportation 2026

blocks.text: SINOTRUK is presenting a range of battery electric trucks, electric powertrain technologies and integrated energy solutions at IAA Transportation 2026, spanning long-haul logistics, construction transport and urban distribution. A centerpiece of the show is the SITRAK 4×2 battery-electric tractor for long-haul logistics. With a curb weight of just 10.1 tonnes and a gross combination weight (GCW) of up to 44 tonnes, the truck delivers greater payload capacity without compromising transport efficiency. Optimized aerodynamic design, energy management and energy recovery help the truck consume as little as 1.1 kWh per kilometer.
